title: Checkout latency spike during deploy
summary: Checkout p99 latency rose from 300ms to 4.2s for 42 minutes during a schema migration.
impact: 2.1% of checkout attempts timed out; no payments were double-charged.
root_cause: A blocking index build on payments-db during the deploy serialized write queries.

title: Cache fleet OOM restarts
summary: Rolling OOM kills on the cache fleet raised tail latencies for 55 minutes.
impact: p99 API latency up 40%; no user-facing errors.
root_cause: A memory-hungry key pattern deployed the previous evening.

title: Legacy billing outage (pre-instrumentation)
summary: Billing was down before timestamped alerting existed.
